# 不怂

> 不怂的个人博客

This is the llms.txt file for 不怂. It provides a machine-readable directory of published articles and core pages for Large Language Models.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://pwkdrive.xyz/): Main blog entrance and latest post stream.
- [About](https://pwkdrive.xyz/about/): Author profile, technical stack, and background.
- [Archive](https://pwkdrive.xyz/archive/): Chronological index of all published writings.

## Articles
- [一个人练推拉，也能慢慢变强](https://pwkdrive.xyz/posts/fitness-push-pull/): 推拉休循环，不练腿，一个人练，空杆就是现在的正式重量。
